# Sensor Acquisition and Signal Processing

::: {.callout-note title="Planned chapter"}
This chapter is a **teaching outline**, not yet a complete lesson. Chapter 1 and Lab 1 are the initial finished materials.
:::

## Learning objectives

- Apply MATLAB to collect, inspect, filter, segment, and characterize sensor measurements in MATLAB.
- Build and interpret an experiment relevant to embedded constraints.
- Identify software, target-hardware, and reproducibility requirements.

## MATLAB workflow (planned)

The chapter will introduce a reproducible example, train or implement a baseline where appropriate, perform a controlled comparison, and explain how the results affect embedded deployment.

## Experimental investigation (planned)

Students will vary one design choice, record metrics and a MATLAB plot, and discuss limitations. Future lab materials will provide the runnable scripts.

## Exercises (planned)

1. Explain the core system design trade-off in your own words.
2. Implement or adapt a MATLAB example related to the chapter.
3. Report predictive and resource metrics, distinguishing measured from estimated values.
